title: Welcome to the Dungeon!
setup_text: Three pressure plates rest before three heavy stone arches. Each arch features an ancient runic carving of a classic creature: a dragon, an owl, and a snake. Inscription above the arches: 'Only the one who treads the pathway of the hunter may pass unscathed; the beast of wisdom flies high, the drake reigns over the mountains, and the serpent crawls in the dust.'
solution: Step on the Owl plate first, then the Dragon plate, and finally the Snake plate, mimicking the descending order of flight and crawl altitude.
hints: Think about relative altitude and height.
The owl flies highest of all.
The snake remains firmly on the dusty ground.

title: The Cryptic Cipher
setup_text: The inscription on the locked sarcophagus says: 'The child of the sun is born in fire, raised in water, and dies in air.' What is it?
hints: Water meets flame to make it.
It rises up but vanishes into the sky.
